purpose: Read-only supplier probe for zero-cost Markdown-to-PDF conversion on Ubuntu.
goal: Inspect local/Ubuntu availability for pandoc and practical PDF engines without mutating the capability registry.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
for P in pandoc weasyprint wkhtmltopdf texlive-latex-base; do
  echo ===${P}_POLICY===
  apt-cache policy "$P" || true
  echo ===${P}_SHOW===
  apt-cache show "$P" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(Package|Version|SHA256|Installed-Size|Description):' | head -n 24 || true
done
for X in pandoc weasyprint wkhtmltopdf pdflatex; do
  printf '%s=' "$X"; command -v "$X" || true
done
echo PDF_CONVERTER_PROBE_COMPLETE
